dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, do you get up early on weekdays?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, duː juː ˈɡɛt ˈʌp ˈɜːrli ɑːn ˈwiːkdeɪz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, at six. But Fah gets up at half past five.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ət ˈsɪks. bʌt ˈfɑː ˈɡɛts ˈʌp ət ˈhæf ˈpæst ˈfaɪv.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Her school is far, and she's never late.
dialogue.reading: hɜːr ˈskuːl ɪz ˈfɑːr, ənd ʃiːz ˈnɛvər ˈleɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She doesn't get up early. She often gets up at ten!
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈdʌzənt ˈɡɛt ˈʌp ˈɜːrli. ʃiː ˈɔːfən ˈɡɛts ˈʌp ət ˈtɛn!
